'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Attacks on civilians in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****A [[Russia]]n [[9K720 Iskander|Iskander-K]] [[ballistic missile]] destroys an apartment complex in [[Kramatorsk]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], killing at least three people and injuring 20 others, according to local officials. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-rocket-destroys-apartment-building-kramatorsk-two-dead-governor-2023-02-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 offensive (2022–2023)|M23 offensive]]
***[[March 23 Movement|M23]] [[insurgent]]s capture the town of Kitshanga in [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], after days of heavy fighting. The [[Land Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|DRC army]] confirms the withdrawal of its troops from the town, saying that it was a "tactical move to protect [[civilian]]s". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/2/1/m23-rebels-take-control-of-kitshanga-in-eastern-dr-congo (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Northwestern Syria clashes (December 2022–present)|Northwestern Syria clashes]]
***Eight [[Syrian Army|soldiers]] are killed near [[Kafr Rumah]] in [[Idlib Governorate]] by [[Tahrir al-Sham]] militants. [https://www.barrons.com/news/jihadists-kill-eight-soldiers-in-northwest-syria-monitor-01675271407 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[2018–2023 Haitian crisis]]
**[[Prime Minister of Jamaica|Jamaican Prime Minister]] [[Andrew Holness]] says that his [[Politics of Jamaica|government]] is willing to send [[Jamaica Defence Force|troops]] to [[Haiti]] as part of a "multinational security assistance deployment". [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/jamaica-willing-take-part-military-intervention-haiti-pm-says-2023-02-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Lebanese liquidity crisis]]
**The [[Banque du Liban|central bank]] of [[Lebanon]] devalues the [[Lebanese pound]] by 90% amid an ongoing [[financial crisis]]. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/currencies/lebanon-devalue-currency-by-90-feb-1-cbank-chief-says-2023-01-31/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021–present United Kingdom cost of living crisis]]
**More than 500,000 workers across multiple [[public sector]]s go on [[Strike action|strike]] in the [[United Kingdom]], forcing thousands of schools to close and many services to be delayed or cancelled, amid disputes over pay and working conditions. It is the largest [[industrial action]] in the UK since 2010. [https://www.cnbc.com/2023/02/01/uk-strikes-half-a-million-brits-are-taking-part-in-the-biggest-walkout-for-12-years.html (CNBC)]
*[[2021–2023 inflation surge]]
**[[United States|U.S.]] [[payment service provider]] [[PayPal]] announces that it will cut around 2,000 jobs, about 7% of its workforce, citing the "challenging macro-economic environment". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-64479649 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[January 31 – February 2, 2023 ice storm]]
**Eight people are killed by a [[winter storm]] in [[Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/deadly-ice-storm-rages-texas-causing-travel-chaos-outages-rcna68531 (NBC News)]
*Two people are injured after a magnitude 6 earthquake hits [[Monkayo]], [[Davao de Oro]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/regions/859416/injuries-damaged-houses-reported-after-magnitude-6-davao-de-oro-quake-ocd/story/ (GMA News Online)]
*One person is injured after a magnitude 4.4 earthquake hits [[Banjar, West Java|Banjar]], [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://bandung.kompas.com/read/2023/02/02/093752578/gempa-magnitudo-43-guncang-garut-puluhan-rumah-di-2-kecamatan-rusak-1-orang (Kompas.com)]
*Three people are killed and 32 others are injured after a fire in a hospital in [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]]. [https://apnews.com/article/egypt-cairo-fires-health-4017d03775163d9c0b0a888cb8d5116b (AP)]
'''Health and environment'''
*[[Western Australian radioactive capsule incident]]
**A search team from the [[Australian Nuclear Science and Technology Organisation]] and [[Department of Fire and Emergency Services|WA Fire and Emergency Services]] announces that they have found the missing [[caesium-137]] capsule around {{convert|74|km|mi|abbr=on}} south of [[Newman, Western Australia|Newman]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2023-02-01/australian-radioactive-capsule-found-in-wa-outback-rio-tinto/101917828 (ABC News Australia)]
*The [[East Epi (volcano)|East Epi]] [[submarine volcano]] in [[Vanuatu]] erupts for the first time since 2004, sending ash 90 meters into the air, with a 10 kilometer radius danger zone. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2023/02/01/vanuatu-volcano-underwater-eruption-pacific/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/483451/underwater-volcano-in-vanuatu-erupts (RNZ)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Four people are killed and five others are injured after a mass shooting in [[KwaMashu]], [[Durban]],  [[South Africa]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/four-killed-south-african-township-shooting-2023-02-01/ (Reuters)]
'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021–2023 Myanmar civil war]]
**[[2023 Myanmar general election]]
***Two years after [[Tatmadaw|Myanmar's military]] [[2021 Myanmar coup d'état|overthrew]] [[Myanmar|the country]]'s [[National League for Democracy|democratically-elected government]], the [[State Administration Council]] extends the country's [[state of emergency]] for another six months, thereby postponing the [[Elections in Myanmar|general election]] initially scheduled for August 1.
